text: A bony, angular figure shows wrinkled skin on the neck, a bony shoulder and a sharply protruding, weapon-like shoulder blade.
quote: the wrinkled skin on her neck, the boney shoulder and weapon-like scapula

text: A heavy, muscular man leaning forward with an upward-thrust back and a slack, hanging arm reads like a lazy bull: powerful but idle.
quote: Notice how each foot was handled differently based on its function to the pose. This feels like a lazy bull.

text: An inverted-triangle silhouette, wide at the top and narrowing to a point below, reads as an athletic, dynamic figure and is often used for villains.
quote: With its point downward, the triangle can represent an athleticfigure. It is also often used for villains because of its pointiness and dynamism.

text: A pyramid-shaped body silhouette, narrow on top and wide at the base, reads as solid and immovable.
quote: Flipped around, where the point is on top, the triangle suggests solidity, like a pyramid, unmoving.

text: A round, oval silhouette (the basic shape of an obese figure) has no sharp corners and reads as friendly, soft and safe.
quote: This shape is considered the friendliest of the shape family. No pointy or dangerous corners. In the real world, typically things that are round are soft and safe.

text: A rectangular, square-cut silhouette (the basic shape of a solid figure) reads as strength: wide and low like a foundation, or tall like a column.
quote: This shape defines strength. If stretched horizontally, it feels like a solid base or foundation. Vertically, it is like a column of strength.

text: A large, rounded torso conveys heavy weight and a strong character.
quote: exaggerated facial features and a large, rounded torso, conveying a sense of heavy weight and strong character

text: A large, heavyset father standing with a slumped posture reads as a weary, unhappy middle-aged dad.
quote: a large, heavyset man wearing a cap, polo shirt, and shorts stands with a slumped posture and a weary, unhappy facial expression

text: A very tall, thin man can stroll with a slumped posture, resting all his weight back on his heels.
quote: there was a tall thin man that struck me because of his interesting posture while strolling. He rested all of his weight on the back of his heel.

text: An older man who walks with his toes pointing outward and a wary, guarded bearing reads as suspicious of his surroundings.
quote: He always looks a little suspicious of his surroundings and walks with his toes pointing outward, so I decided to push those qualities in this drawing.

text: Standing with arms crossed and the body leaning backward reads as impatient and judging of the person in front.
quote: The crossed arms and backward lean indicate his judging of her.

text: A slumped seated posture with the head bowed low and heavy shoulders signals exhaustion or sleep.
quote: a person in a slumped, seated posture. The figure's head is bowed low, suggesting exhaustion or sleep
